programme.desc: SEGMEN HIBURAN LAGU-LAGU BAHARU DAN LAMA SERTA PADAT DENGAN INFORMASI UNTUK WANITA, KEKELUARGAAN, SIARAN ULANGAN TERPILIH, CERITA RAKYAT SELAIN PENGUMUMAN KHIDMAT MASYARAKAT/AWAM (CSA/PSA)/PROMO/KAPSUL.

programme.title: RADIO TAU (LIMBANGfm)
programme.desc: SEGMEN PERKHIDMATAN LUN BAWANG (LIMBANGfm) DARI 12.00-3.00 P.M. MENAMPILKAN LAGU-LAGU RAKYAT/MALAR SEGAR/KEAGAMAAN, MAKLUMAT TERKINI, BERITA KELUARGA , PSA/CSA, PROMO, JINGLE, KAPSUL DAN TEASER RANCANGAN.

programme.title: PEJI DAHIN KELO' (MIRIfm)
programme.desc: SEGMEN PERKHIDMATAN KAYAN (MIRIfm) DARI 3.00-5.00 P.M. DENGAN PENGISIAN LAGU-LAGU, INFO TERKINI, BERITA KELUARGA, PSA/CSA, KAPSUL, CARTA LAGU, LAGU KEROHANIAN, PROGRAM KANAK-KANAK DAN MUZIK TRADISIONAL.

programme.title: PEMUNG KEJAIE (MIRIfm)
programme.desc: SEGMEN PERKHIDMATAN KENYAH (MIRIfm) DARI 5.00-6.00 P.M. DENGAN PENGISIAN PROGRAM BERSAMA AGENSI, MOTIVASI, SEMBANG BUDAYA, CARTA LAGU ORANG ULU, PROGRAM KANAK-KANAK, LAGU-LAGU PERMINTAAN, BERITA KELUARGA.

programme.title: SADA LEMAI (WAIfm IBAN)
programme.desc: WAIfm IBAN DARI 6.00-9.00 P.M. DENGAN PENGISIAN PROGRAM BUAL BICARA, DRAMA, PROGRAM KANAK-KANAK, BERITA KELUARGA/MENCARI SAUDARA-MARA YANG HILANG, INFO TERKINI, PILIHAN LAGU LAMA/MALAR SEGAR/FOLKLORE.

programme.title: PEMERINDANG MALAM (WAIfm IBAN)
programme.desc: SEGMEN SANTAI MALAM MENGANDUNGI PILIHAN LAGU-LAGU NOSTALGIA/MALAR SEGAR, FOLKLORE (SANGGAI, RAMBAN, SAMPI, TIMANG JALONG/PELIAN, ENSERA, GANU/JAWANG/DUNGAI, RENONG/SUGI), SELAIN INFO PDRM, KISAH BENAR.

programme.desc: Watch these together.. but maybe don't try to eat them. This week, Amy Shuster is at the Warkworth Maple Syrup Festival and then heads to Zibelemärit — The Onion Market & Festival in Bern, Switzerland. It's so great you'll cry!

programme.title: German Christmas Market
programme.desc: Discover a true Christmas wonderland as Amy Shuster visits Germany's Christkindlmarkt, a Christmas festival dating back to the 16th century.

programme.title: Over the Top Holiday Cakes
programme.desc: Mia Starr gives a crash course in her all-time favorite, most used decorating techniques. From piping styles to watercolor frosting to maximalist designs, she teaches the basics of holiday cake decorating, in her own signature style.

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Bakes Around The World
programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.title: Hack Your Holidays
programme.desc: In this episode, you don’t even need to turn on your oven! From a jaw-dropping cake hack, to fried biscuit donuts, you won’t believe what you can do with pre-made desserts from the supermarket. Mia will show hacks and great tips for any home-baker!

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: Bake in the New Year!
programme.desc: Mia is ringing in the new year with these chic bakes. Fortune cookies for luck, a champagne dessert, a gilded, tuxedo inspired cake-over, and a cocktail to keep you awake until midnight. The only thing missing from the celebration is the ball drop!

programme.title: Italian Classics
programme.desc: On this episode, we're going to show you some of our favorite Italian classics. Pasta, pizza, and more... you name it, we've got it. So, what are you waiting for? It's time to get cooking!

programme.title: A Trip to Latin America
programme.desc: We hope you brought your passport, because we're heading to Latin America! Whether it's breakfast, lunch, dinner or dessert, we're going to show you some delicious dishes, each with their own unique Latin flair!

programme.desc: Today, we'll be exploring cool cuisines from our neighboor south of the border. From breakfast to traditional fare, all the way to guac and salsa, and ending with dessert. We'll showcase some great dishes and let you know which one is our favorite.

programme.desc: Today we've got pizza all day for you: in the morning, in the evening, literally any time you want! Not only will we share some great recipes but we will let you know which ones are our favorites too. What are we waiting for? Let's get to the pizza!

programme.title: Cheese!
programme.desc: Today, it's all about cheese: from the melted gooey-ness to just plain old slices, cheese makes the world go round. We'll showcase recipes that feature cheese in all forms. So strap in, it's time to get cheesy.

programme.title: Comfort Food!
programme.desc: On this episode, it's time to get cozy with some of our favorite Tastemade comfort food recipes. Get cozy and settle in for what's sure to be a mouth-watering journey!

programme.title: Grill It Up
programme.desc: It's time to Grill. It. Up! From side dishes to main courses, we're going to show you some of our favorite recipes to make using your backyard BBQ. Let's turn up the heat, it's time to get cooking!

programme.title: Breakfast All Day

programme.title: Perfectly Prepared Steaks

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill

programme.title: Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep6
programme.desc: Rakan-rakan Oya sengana membiarkan Oya dan Mika bersendirian dengan harapan mereka berdua dapat berbaik semula. Namun niat mereka itu disalah anggap oleh Oya.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep7
programme.desc: Icha dan Umai merasa sangat bersalah terhadap Oya dan cuba untuk memohon maaf. Semua pelajar risau dengan tugasan yang diberikan oleh pensyarah mereka.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep8
programme.desc: Mika mahu Oya menolong membuat tugasannya jika tidak mahu rahsia Oya terbongkar. Pertemuan Oya dengan kawan lamanya, Jaja membuatkan Oya merasa bersemangat untuk belajar semula.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep9
programme.desc: Semua rakan-rakan Oya masih risaukan Oya yang kelihatan terlalu rapat dengan Jaja, kerana Jaja sering berpewatakan seperti lelaki. Mereka mahu Mika memikat hati Oya.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123 Ep10
programme.desc: Oya terkejut kerana mendapat bungkusan hadiah daripada pengirim yang tidak dikenali. Tanpa disangka, Oya semakin pandai menggunakan ilmu kejururawatan untuk menolong orang yang cedera.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep16
programme.desc: Selepas kematian Tok Wan, Ilah berhasrat untuk membatalkan perkahwinan Ainnura dengan Fariz. Bagaimanapun Ainnura bertegas untuk meneruskan rancangan mereka kerana itu juga yang dimahukan oleh Tok Wan demi meliah keluarga Ainnura dan keluarga Fariz berdamai. Rohana menyokong keputusan Ainnura dan ini menyebabkan Ilah kecil hati dengan Ainnura. Ilah akhirnya tidak hadir pada hari perkahwinan Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep17
programme.desc: Sikap prihatin dan baik Rohana terhadap Ainnura akhirnya terbongkar apabila tujuan Rohana merestui hasrat Fariz untuk megahwini Ainnura hanyalah semata-mata untuk membalas dendam pada Ainnura. Rohana paksa Ainnura tinggal bersamanya dan jika Ainnura menujuk Fariz supaya keluar dari rumah tersebut, dia tidak halal susu yang diminum oleh Fariz serta menganggap Fariz anak derhaka. Sementara itu, dalam diam Ilah sebenarnya merindui Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep18
programme.desc: Rohana sengaja menyeksa fizikal dan mental Ainnura. Fazira melihat apa yang dilakukan oleh Rohana terhadap Ainnura lalu mendesak Ainnura dan Fariz keluar dari rumah tersebut. Bagaimanapun Ainnura enggan kerana tidak mahu Fariz dianggap sebagai anak derhaka. Gara-hara terlalu marah dengan Ainnura, Rohana telah menghentak kepala Ainnura ke dinding. Fariz perasan dengan bengkak di kepala Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep19
programme.desc: Ainnura berbohong dengan Fariz yang bengkak di kepalanya akiat terhantuk pada sinki. Dalam waktu yang sama, Rohana mendakwa Ainnura sengaja menolaknya sehinggakan dia hampir terjatuh. Fateha menyokong kata-kata Rohana, menyebabkan Fariz keliru siapakah yang benar di antara isteri dan ibunya. Ainnura bangkit mempertahankan haknya. Selain daripada Ainnura, Fawwaz turut menjadi mangsa Rohana dan Fateha dengan pelbagai penghinaan sehingga akhirnya kerana tidak sanggup melihat Fawwaz dihina, Fazira mengakui yang Fawwaz adalah anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep20
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks. Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue. She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From the funniest feline fails, to the cutest of kittens we've dug out the very best the internet has to offer, and we've the cream of the crop right here.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: This programme finds Dr. Matt battling to fix a greyhound's broken leg to get it back on the track. We meet Matt's wife, Claire, a horse vet, who uses the latest technology to treat three troubled racehorses. But down on the farm Matt finds the old-fashioned way is best when it comes to finding out if a cow is pregnant.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Dagenham a terrified Jack Russell called Phoebe is found abandoned in a travellers' site full of rubbish. Surrounded by danger and left with a badly broken leg she must undergo a three hour operation but will she ever be able to walk again?

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The charm of cute rabbits is irresistible! An old man raised hundreds of rabbits?! Playful little rabbits are spoiled yet timid! What should beginners pay attention to when raising rabbits?! Shocking! Rabbits can be poisoned by eating carrots?! Rabbits have a very bad temper?! They kick people they don't like?! Crazy about rabbits! Caregivers takes care of the little rabbits "wholeheartedly"?!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.desc: Dr. Matt travels to the moors above Whitby on the Yorkshire Coast to treat Bobo, an eight-year-old Capuchin. Meanwhile Samantha the scarlet macaw rules the roost and is displaying complete disobedience.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes arranges a warrant to rescue four dogs from a dangerously overcrowded house. After an unfriendly welcome it becomes clear that at least one of the dogs will need medical attention but their diagnosis turns out much more serious than expected.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.

programme.desc: Early morning - and Dr. Matt is on a routine visit to Flamingoland, near Malton, in North Yorkshire. As a specialist in exotic animals, he oversees the care of all the park's unusual inhabitants. Today, Matt's in for some donkey work. He's down on the children's farm for a spot of dentistry on a young donkey that proves to be a bit of a handful.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Project Legion
programme.desc: A young man trapped in his apartment with a swarm of demons outside his door must find a way to survive the night and escape from apartment 213.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: Broken Star
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Ep05 Kegembiraan Roz dapat menyelamatkan Rin terbantut apabila penculik Rin telah melepaskan diri daripada tahanan polis. Roz juga mengaitkan kes penculikan Rin dengan kes Dr Kaos Jr yang terlepas dari penjara dengan rancangan jahat yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Ep07 Daniel marah kerana pembanteras jenayah melalkukan kerja polis dengan menangkap penjenayah-penjenayah. Tanpa dia ketahui itu adalah kerja ibunya sendiri. programme.desc: 克里斯和凱德正在追蹤一頭巨大的雄駝鹿，凱德準備開槍。與此同時，凱西和R.L.仍在尋找大型獵物。河水位依然高峻且狂野。

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E07 - Swoop and Scoop
programme.desc: Wiedie y Chris diseñaron sus vidas para poder experimentar todo lo que Jackson Hole tiene que ofrecer. Y cuando el primer paseo en moto de nieve de un joven se descontrola, unen sus fuerzas a las de Jess y Flip para ejecutar un rescate perfecto.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue - S01:E08 - No Short Cuts
programme.desc: Tim exige mucho de todos los que le rodean, especialmente durante un rescate en una cueva, que él describe como el peor tipo de rescate.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E09 - Gold, Sweat and Dragon's Blood
programme.desc: Tom and Kia explore a mysterious mine in Colorado.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones
programme.desc: 真實故事將我們帶入一個簡單的皇室愛情故事。它提供了一個王子如何愛上一個普通中產階級女孩的幕後花絮。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E05 - Operation Wildfire
programme.desc: 在本集Wardens中，我們正在尋找一隻麻煩的熊，它一直在翻找鄰里的垃圾。與此同時，在另一個地方，我們對一群人因無照釣魚而給予罰單。

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E09 - Weary Travellers

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E01 - From There to Here

programme.desc: La Luna, nuestra compañera celeste más cercana. Nuestra indispensable pareja de baile a través del cosmos. Iluminando nuestro cielo nocturno y tirando suavemente de nuestras costas. programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E01 - Python Invasion

En este episodio, Manny Puig busca serpientes gigantes que han invadido los Everglades.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E02 - Still Waters Run Red
programme.desc: Manny Puig explora el peligro que acecha bajo los canales de Florida.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E03 - Canal Monster
programme.desc: Mientras sigue explorando los canales artificiales de Florida, un enorme caimán ataca a Manny.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E04 - Sharks of the Gulf Stream
programme.desc: Manny atrae a los tiburones más peligrosos de la corriente del golfo.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - SO1:E05 - Volcanic Kingfish
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for Kingfish, Rick Pollock. They fish the the coast of New Zealand just off a live volcano, then tragedy strikes, after the volcano erupts, Mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E06 - Mountain Monsters - Red Stag
programme.desc: After being dropped off into the mountains where there were only whispers and tales of mountain monsters being seen. Mario is on the search of the outer limits of the mountains to find himself a monster red deer.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E07 - Boars and Prehistoric Fish
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong. Drama strikes and Mario finds himself in crocodile infested water plucking fish out.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E08 - Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Mario enjoys the camaraderie and challenge of duck hunting on opening day, and then teaches the audience how to cook an ancient Chinese recipe with one of the leading chefs of an award-winning restaurant from New Zealand.

programme.desc: Amid the ancient canyon geology of west Texas run herds of desert mule deer and for Laramy Miller the hunt is on for one special buck.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E03 - Black Bear
